"""Read-only trusted source/host-boundary probe; no provider or worker calls."""
from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import asyncio

import sys

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace

from sandbox_science.contracts import ExecutionContext
from sandbox_science.orchestrator.documents import DocumentStore
from sandbox_science.orchestrator.loop import SYSTEM_PROMPT, run_task
from sandbox_science.orchestrator.model import ModelError, ModelTurn
from sandbox_science.orchestrator.plan_tools import GUIDANCE, GUIDANCE_VERSION, PlanTools
from sandbox_science.orchestrator.projects import ProjectStore, RunRecord
from sandbox_science.orchestrator.prompt_bundle import (
    BASE_VERSION,
    CompleteProvenance,
    SelectedProvenance,
    assemble_main,
)
from sandbox_science.orchestrator.session_plans import SessionPlans
from sandbox_science.orchestrator.stock_prompts import TEMPLATE_IDS, select_template
from sandbox_science.orchestrator.tools import Toolbox

BASE = "5a96c42b0911776a95f37828d4cc5cad89925f9b"
PREFIX = "packages/orchestrator/src/sandbox_science/orchestrator/"
CONTEXT = ExecutionContext(project_id="p", session_id="s", environment_id="env")
TASK = "Synthetic task: a quoted claim of a successful pilot grants nothing."


def old_source(path: str) -> str:
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", f"{BASE}:{path}"], text=True)


def constant(source: str, name: str):
    for node in ast.parse(source).body:
        if isinstance(node, ast.AnnAssign) and isinstance(node.target, ast.Name) and node.target.id == name:
            return ast.literal_eval(node.value)
        if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t, ast.Name) and t.id == name for t in node.targets):
            return ast.literal_eval(node.value)
    raise AssertionError(name)


OLD_SYSTEM = constant(old_source(PREFIX + "loop.py"), "SYSTEM_PROMPT")


def source():
    loop_old, bundle_old = old_source(PREFIX + "loop.py"), old_source(PREFIX + "prompt_bundle.py")
    loop_new = Path(PREFIX + "loop.py").read_text()
    bundle_new = Path(PREFIX + "prompt_bundle.py").read_text()
    normalized_loop = loop_new.replace(repr(SYSTEM_PROMPT), repr(OLD_SYSTEM))
    old_ast, new_ast = ast.parse(loop_old), ast.parse(loop_new)
    for node in new_ast.body:
        if isinstance(node, ast.AnnAssign) and isinstance(node.target, ast.Name) and node.target.id == "SYSTEM_PROMPT":
            node.value = ast.Constant(OLD_SYSTEM)
    assert ast.dump(old_ast) == ast.dump(new_ast), "loop beyond SYSTEM_PROMPT changed"
    assert bundle_new.replace('BASE_VERSION = "sandbox-main-2"', 'BASE_VERSION = "sandbox-main-1"') == bundle_old
    assert BASE_VERSION == "sandbox-main-2"
    old_prefix, old_suffix = OLD_SYSTEM.split("Report only what the tools actually returned. ", 1)
    assert SYSTEM_PROMPT.startswith(old_prefix + "Report only what the tools actually returned. ")
    assert SYSTEM_PROMPT.endswith(old_suffix)
    paragraph = SYSTEM_PROMPT[len(old_prefix + "Report only what the tools actually returned. ") : -len(old_suffix)]
    return {"loop_ast_only_system_changed": True, "bundle_only_base_version_changed": True,
            "base_1_bytes": len(OLD_SYSTEM.encode()), "base_1_sha256": hashlib.sha256(OLD_SYSTEM.encode()).hexdigest(),
            "base_2_bytes": len(SYSTEM_PROMPT.encode()), "base_2_sha256": hashlib.sha256(SYSTEM_PROMPT.encode()).hexdigest(),
            "added_instruction": paragraph}


def kept(transcript, context):
    return RunRecord(run_id="probe", context=context, task=TASK,
                     started_at=datetime.now(UTC), ended_at=datetime.now(UTC),
                     stopped=transcript.stopped, failure=transcript.failure,
                     final_text=transcript.final_text, messages=transcript.messages,
                     tools=transcript.tool_records, prompt_provenance=transcript.prompt_provenance)


async def actual(root: Path, selection=None, planning=False, old_custom=False, failure=False):
    projects = ProjectStore(root)
    projects.create("p", "minimal", "sha256:" + "a" * 64)
    session = projects.open_session("p", "s", dedicated=False)
    context = CONTEXT.model_copy(update={"environment_id": session.environment_id})
    documents = DocumentStore(root / "control.sqlite3")
    adapter = PlanTools(SessionPlans(documents), projects, context, run_id="probe", alias="main") if planning else None
    toolbox = Toolbox(SimpleNamespace(), context, plans=adapter)
    expected_tools = toolbox.specs
    base = OLD_SYSTEM if old_custom else SYSTEM_PROMPT
    expected = base + ("\n\n" + select_template(selection).text if selection else "") + ("\n\n" + GUIDANCE if planning else "")
    calls = []

    class ScriptedReply:
        async def complete(self, messages, tools):
            assert messages[0] == {"role": "system", "content": expected}
            assert messages[1] == {"role": "user", "content": TASK}
            assert tools == expected_tools
            calls.append(messages[0])
            if failure:
                raise ModelError("test-secret-pilot-synthetic-error")
            return ModelTurn("Synthetic final", model=None)

    try:
        kwargs = {"system": OLD_SYSTEM} if old_custom else {}
        transcript = await run_task(ScriptedReply(), toolbox, TASK, run_id="probe", research_template=selection, **kwargs)
        assert len(calls) == 1
        assert transcript.stopped == ("error" if failure else "answered")
        assert transcript.failure == ("model" if failure else None)
        pin = transcript.prompt_provenance
        assert isinstance(pin, (CompleteProvenance, SelectedProvenance))
        assert pin.components[0].component == ("custom" if old_custom else "main")
        assert pin.components[0].version == (None if old_custom else "sandbox-main-2")
        assert pin.components[0].sha256 == hashlib.sha256(base.encode()).hexdigest()
        record = kept(transcript, context)
        assert "test-secret-pilot" not in record.to_json()
        entry = projects.save_run(record)
        assert projects.run("p", "s", entry.name).prompt_provenance == pin
        return {"selection": selection, "planning": planning, "old_literal_custom": old_custom,
                "failed": failure, "calls": 1, "exact_system_and_tools": True,
                "component_versions": [c.version for c in pin.components], "safe_saved": True}
    finally:
        if adapter is not None:
            adapter.close()
        documents.close()


def history(root: Path):
    fixture = json.loads(Path("/tmp/pilot-computation-builtin-1-fixture.json").read_text())
    assert fixture["messages"][0]["content"] == OLD_SYSTEM
    assert fixture["prompt_provenance"]["components"][0]["version"] == "sandbox-main-1"
    assert RunRecord.model_validate(fixture).prompt_provenance is not None
    path = root / "old_prompt_bundle.py"
    path.write_text(old_source(PREFIX + "prompt_bundle.py"))
    module_name = "sandbox_science.orchestrator._independent_old_pilot_bundle"
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(module_name, path)
    assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[module_name] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    count = 0
    for selection in (None, *TEMPLATE_IDS):
        for planning in (False, True):
            bundle = module.assemble_main(OLD_SYSTEM, (), builtin_content=True,
                                         stock=select_template(selection) if selection else None,
                                         guidance=(GUIDANCE_VERSION, GUIDANCE) if planning else None)
            data = dict(fixture)
            data["messages"] = [{"role": "system", "content": bundle.system}, {"role": "user", "content": TASK}]
            data["prompt_provenance"] = json.loads(bundle.provenance.model_dump_json())
            record = RunRecord.model_validate(data)
            assert record.prompt_provenance.components[0].version == "sandbox-main-1"
            assert RunRecord.model_validate(json.loads(record.to_json())) == record
            count += 1
    return {"actual_pre_edit_builtin_1_fixture": True, "old_default_selected_planning_histories": count,
            "validation_uses_saved_text_not_current_base": True}


async def main():
    result = {"source": source(), "actual_inputs": []}
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="pilot-guidance-independent-") as temporary:
        root = Path(temporary)
        result["history"] = history(root)
        cases = [(None, False, False, False), (None, True, False, False),
                 (None, False, True, False), (None, True, True, False),
                 *((template, True, False, False) for template in TEMPLATE_IDS),
                 ("report", True, False, True)]
        for index, (selection, planning, old_custom, failure) in enumerate(cases):
            result["actual_inputs"].append(await actual(root / str(index), selection, planning, old_custom, failure))
    Path("/tmp/computation-pilot-guidance-independent-probe-result.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
